sources.title: ONS UK Environmental Accounts: 2026 bulletin
facts: Residence-basis greenhouse-gas emissions are distinct from territorial estimates.
The bulletin reports 2024 environmental-account emissions and energy-use context.
Industry and household contributions must retain ONS accounting scope.

sources.title: ONS UK Environmental Accounts: 2026 release
facts: The release links accredited environmental-account datasets for 1990 to 2024.
Energy and atmospheric-emissions datasets have separate definitions and tables.
Release metadata does not create parcel-level measurements.

sources.title: ONS Energy use: total
facts: Dataset covers UK direct and reallocated energy use to 2024.
Industry categories follow SIC-based environmental-account structure.
Energy use is not itself a parcel greenhouse-gas measurement.

sources.title: ONS Energy use: fossil fuels by fuel type and industry
facts: Dataset covers fossil-fuel use by industry and fuel type to 2024.
Revision metadata must be preserved when comparing editions.
Fuel use must not be silently converted to parcel emissions.

sources.title: ONS Energy use: renewable and waste sources
facts: Dataset covers renewable and waste energy use by source and industry to 2024.
Renewable-energy use is an activity measure with defined accounting scope.
No individual parcel value follows without a separate binding method.

sources.title: ONS Energy use: by industry, source and fuel
facts: Dataset disaggregates energy use by industry, source and fuel.
Source and fuel classifications must be retained during reuse.
Activity data and measured greenhouse-gas emissions are not interchangeable.

sources.title: ONS Energy use: fossil fuels by fuel type
facts: Dataset reports UK fuel use by fuel type to 2024.
The table excludes biofuels and waste.
No unsupported emissions conversion is permitted.

sources.title: ONS UK Environmental Accounts 2026 detailed bulletin
facts: The bulletin reports 478 MtCO2e on a residence basis for 2024.
Residence-basis statistics include UK residents and registered businesses outside UK territory.
These figures must not be conflated with DESNZ territorial estimates.

sources.title: Ofgem BUS monthly scheme update
facts: Figures are updated through 30 June 2026.
Applications, vouchers and grants are scheme-administration measures.
Scheme uptake is not measured greenhouse-gas abatement at parcel level.

sources.title: Ofgem BUS guidance for installers
facts: Version 5.1 applies to relevant applications from 28 April 2026.
Uplifted eligible off-gas-grid grant values apply from 21 July 2026.
Eligibility guidance is not an emissions observation.

sources.title: Ofgem Boiler Upgrade Scheme
facts: BUS operates in England and Wales.
Current grant categories include heat-pump and biomass technologies.
Grant values and eligibility must not be interpreted as measured carbon savings.

sources.title: Ofgem BUS Product Eligibility List
facts: Product Eligibility List was updated 23 July 2026.
Product listing does not guarantee eligibility in every application.
Product eligibility is not parcel emissions evidence.

sources.title: UK ETS technical guidance and tools
facts: 2026 country-specific carbon emission factors were published 24 July 2026.
UK ETS factors support monitoring and reporting under specified circumstances.
Emission factors are not direct parcel measurements.

sources.title: DfT statistics landing page
facts: Latest transport statistics list SAF and RTFO fifth provisional releases on 23 July 2026.
Vehicle licensing January to March 2026 was published 15 July 2026.
Transport and environment 2024 was published 14 July 2026.

sources.title: DESNZ UK greenhouse gas emissions 2026 provisional announcement
facts: The 2026 provisional figures release is scheduled for March 2027.
A future release announcement is not observed 2026 emissions data.
The announcement describes territorial provisional methodology context.

sources.title: Defra UK and England carbon footprint future announcement
facts: The next carbon-footprint release is scheduled for May to June 2027.
Consumption-based footprint accounting differs from territorial accounting.
Future release metadata must not be treated as observed statistics.

sources.title: DESNZ Energy trends July to September 2026 announcement
facts: Release date is 29 September 2026.
The announcement covers future monthly energy production, trade, generation, consumption and prices.
Future release dates are not observed values.

sources.title: DfT SAF Mandate statistics data tables
facts: Fifth provisional 2025 tables are based on data available 8 July 2026.
The dataset remains incomplete until final publication in November 2026.
Provisional fuel-supply data must retain provisional status.

sources.title: DfT SAF Mandate 2025 fifth provisional release
facts: Release reports January to December 2025 SAF supply based on data available 8 July 2026.
The dataset is explicitly incomplete and provisional.
Finalised 2025 data are expected in November 2026.

sources.title: DfT Transport and environment statistics 2024 announcement
facts: Release date was confirmed for 14 July 2026.
Announcement scope covers greenhouse gases and air pollutants by transport mode.
Announcement metadata must not substitute for the released statistical tables.

sources.title: DESNZ BUS approved grant categories and values notice
facts: Approved categories and values became effective 21 July 2026.
The notice applies to England and Wales.
Grant categories are policy/eligibility data rather than measured emissions.

sources.title: DfT Transport and environment statistics 2024
facts: Domestic transport emitted 110.4 MtCO2e in 2024 according to the release.
The release distinguishes greenhouse gases from air pollutants.
National transport statistics must not be assigned to individual parcels.

sources.title: DfT SAF Mandate statistics collection
facts: Collection identifies fifth provisional 2025 release as latest on 23 July 2026.
Provisional reports can change before the final report.
Mandate obligation and fuel supply are not direct parcel emissions.

sources.title: DfT SAF fifth provisional release announcement
facts: The announcement confirmed a 23 July 2026 release date.
It concerns 2025 SAF supply statistics.
Once the release exists, announcement and release must remain distinct records.

sources.title: DESNZ GGR government response
facts: Government response was published 17 July 2026.
It is a policy statement responding to the independent GGR review.
Policy measures and market frameworks are not measured removals at parcel level.

sources.title: DESNZ BUS regulations approved standards and grants
facts: Collection was updated 21 July 2026 with current grant categories and values.
Approved standards and grant levels serve scheme regulation.
Regulatory eligibility is not emissions measurement.

sources.title: DfT RTFO statistics collection
facts: Collection lists RTFO 2025 fifth provisional release on 23 July 2026.
Provisional datasets remain subject to change before finalisation.
Fuel obligation compliance is not parcel greenhouse-gas measurement.

sources.title: DfT Transport energy and environment statistics collection
facts: Collection was updated with Transport and environment statistics 2024.
ENV tables consolidate transport-related environmental statistics.
Collection-level statistics retain their original source definitions.

sources.title: DESNZ GGR government response detailed page
facts: Detailed response references 30 recommendations from the independent review.
Government strategy discusses engineered and nature-based removals and market development.
Strategy and policy ambition must not be recorded as observed removals.

sources.title: DESNZ Energy Trends and Prices statistical release 30 June 2026
facts: Release contains latest provisional monthly UK energy statistics available on 30 June 2026.
Energy production, trade, generation, consumption and prices have separate measures.
Provisional status and reference periods must be preserved.

sources.title: DESNZ Energy Trends collection
facts: Collection provides monthly and quarterly UK energy statistics.
Release chronology must be retained when selecting observations.
Energy trends do not directly bind values to canonical parcels.

sources.title: DESNZ monthly Energy Trends data
facts: National Data Library record links monthly Energy Trends datasets.
Monthly energy statistics use specific reference periods and revisions.
National activity data cannot be assigned to parcels without a verified method.

sources.title: DESNZ quarterly Energy Trends data
facts: National Data Library record links quarterly Energy Trends datasets.
Quarterly and monthly series must not be mixed without period checks.
No parcel inference is permitted.

sources.title: DESNZ Total energy statistics collection
facts: Collection includes annual DUKES and shorter-period Energy Trends products.
Annual and monthly data have different status and reference periods.
Collection metadata alone is not an emissions measurement.

sources.title: DESNZ Energy Consumption in the UK 2025
facts: Publication provides sectoral UK energy-consumption statistics.
Revisions and sector definitions must be preserved.
Consumption statistics do not establish parcel emissions.

sources.title: DESNZ Greenhouse gas reporting conversion factors 2026
facts: 2026 conversion factors support activity-based greenhouse-gas reporting.
Scope and factor type must be retained during calculations.
Factors are not direct measurements and do not justify parcel values without activity data.

sources.title: DESNZ Conversion factors 2026 Code statement
facts: Statement addresses trustworthiness, quality and value of the conversion-factor product.
Quality assurance does not change factor-versus-measurement semantics.
Method version must accompany factor use.

sources.title: Defra Farm Practices Survey February 2026
facts: Survey covers farming practices in England.
Survey responses describe practices and attitudes rather than direct emissions measurements.
Survey geography and sample basis must be preserved.

sources.title: Defra Farm Practices Survey 2026 emissions
facts: Page reports farmer responses concerning emissions-related practices.
Survey implementation percentages are not measured greenhouse-gas reductions.
Survey results cannot be assigned to individual parcels without evidence.

sources.title: Defra Agriculture in the United Kingdom 2025 Chapter 11
facts: Chapter reports agri-environment indicators including estimated agricultural emissions.
National or sector estimates retain their defined methodology and geography.
Sector trends do not provide parcel measurements.

sources.title: NAEI Greenhouse Gas Emissions Data
facts: NAEI provides the 2026 UK Greenhouse Gas Inventory covering 1990 to 2024.
Inventory datasets and future publication dates must be distinguished.
Inventory geography and methodology do not imply parcel binding.

sources.title: Ofgem BUS current scheme overview
facts: Current scheme overview includes £9,000 eligible off-gas-grid heat-pump grants from 21 July 2026 to 31 March 2027.
Ofgem administers the scheme while DESNZ owns policy and legislation.
Scheme administration remains distinct from measured emissions outcomes.

guard_patterns.risk_prevented: scheme activity treated as emissions outcome
future release treated as actual data
